name: orbitalpha-trading
description: Upbit spot signal monitoring, logs, and admin dashboard (trading-only, isolated from other products).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @orbitalpha/shared && npm run build -w @orbitalpha/server && npm run build -w @orbitalpha/dashboard
scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,dash -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @orbitalpha/shared" "npm run dev -w @orbitalpha/server" "npm run dev -w @orbitalpha/dashboard"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @orbitalpha/shared && npm run lint -w @orbitalpha/server && npm run lint -w @orbitalpha/dashboard
